title: Corso and the telepathic steering helmet
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Corso and the telepathic steering helmet, about 1950s at The Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then there's Philip J. Corso, who claimed to be at the Pentagon in the '50s doling out UFO material into the civil or private side world.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes Philip J. Corso, a US Army officer, who claimed that in the 1950s he worked at the Pentagon, the US military headquarters, handing out material from crashed UFOs to private companies and civilian researchers. The story is linked to the idea of a helmet that let a pilot steer a craft with their thoughts, and if true it would mean some modern technology came from studying alien objects.
